title: Hello
cando: greet people, say and spell your name, and ask for someone’s name

about.text: In this lesson you meet new people. You say hello and spell your name. You ask: What's your name?
goals: Say your name: I am Mei. My name is Mei.
Write your name on a list.

chapters.title: Two people meet
chapters.text:
Two people meet at work.
They say hello.
They say: My name is Tomasz.
They ask: What's your name?
Then they say: Nice to meet you.
At the end, they say goodbye.

chapters.title: I am, my name is
chapters.text:
Say your name in two ways.
I am Mei. My name is Mei.
I and am go together.
My name and is go together.
To ask, say: What is your name?
Say please when you ask for something.
Say thank you when you get it.

chapters.title: A class list
chapters.text:
Next, you read a class list.
Find the names on it.
Write your name on the list.
Use capital letters: MEI.
Then copy your name two times.

chapters.title: Meet a classmate
chapters.text:
Then you meet a new classmate.
Say hello and your name.
Spell your name: A-N-A.
Then ask: What's your name?

chapters.title: The book
chapters.text:
Last, you read a short story.
People meet and say hello.
Read it two times.

warmup.prompt: You meet a new person. What do you say?
warmup.note: There is no wrong answer. All three are good. Hi is short and friendly.

conversation.title: Two people meet

Nice to meet you. How do you spell Tomasz?

What does Tomasz say at the end?

sound.title: hello and goodbye
sound.explain: Hello and goodbye have two parts. The second part is strong: he-LLO, good-BYE. Listen, then say each group.

sayIt.instructions: Say Mei's lines. Record yourself. Then listen. Is your name clear?
lines: Nice to meet you. How do you spell Tomasz?

spot.instructions: Look at these lines from the conversation. Look at am and is.
spot.question: Which word comes after I? Which word comes after my name?
spot.answer: After I: am. I am Mei. After my name: is. My name is Tomasz. What's is short for What is.

rules.title: I am, my name is
rule: I am + your name: I am Mei.
My name is + your name: My name is Mei.
Ask: What is your name? Short: What's your name?
Yes, I am. No, I am not.
A coffee, please. Thank you. Sorry, I am late.
rules.mistake: Not: My name Mei. Say: My name is Mei.

practice.why: I goes with am: I am Tomasz.
What is your name? asks for a name.
Yes, I am. No goes with I am not.

liveClass: Day 1: hello and goodbye round the class. Then the lift conversation in pairs, with new names.
Day 2: the task. Each learner meets two classmates. They say and spell their names.
Day 3: talk about the book. Then a spelling game. One learner spells a name. The others write it.
